_comment: Copy to oauth.local.json (gitignored) and fill in. Created in one Google Cloud project so a single consent screen covers both clients: a 'Web application' client whose authorized redirect URI is the bridge page (Chromium), and a 'Desktop app' client whose authorized redirect URI is the loopback address logged at startup (Firefox). See DISTRIBUTION.md. Env vars GOOGLE_OAUTH_WEB_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_OAUTH_NATIVE_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_OAUTH_NATIVE_CLIENT_SECRET take precedence, for CI.
